sentences.english: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Yaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary — feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
